summary.text: Shelly Willingham is a Democratic member of the North Carolina House of Representatives, representing District 23 (Bertie, Edgecombe and Martin counties), for the 2025-2026 session. The General Assembly's member page lists 6.5 terms served in the House.

paragraphs.text: The General Assembly's member page lists Shelly Willingham's occupation as Real Estate Consultant.
